tharal1.m: Walk in the glow of the Shadow, my child.
r: Do you have anything to trade?
What can you tell me about bonemeal?
Do you have anything to help against food-poisoning?

tharal_antifoodp1.m: No, sorry. I hear that the potion-maker in Fallhaven can create something to help against that though.

tharal_antifoodp2.m: You should go see him and ask if he has anything to help against that. He can probably help you.

tharal_bonemeal1.m: Bonemeal? We shouldn't talk about that. Lord Geomyr issued a decree. It's not allowed anymore.

tharal_bonemeal2.m: Well if you really are that persistent. Bring me 5 insect wings that I can use for making potions and maybe we can talk more.
r: Here, I have the insect wings.

tharal_bonemeal2_1.m: No, we really shouldn't talk about that.

tharal_bonemeal3.m: Thanks kid. I knew I could count on you.

tharal_bonemeal4.m: Oh yes, bonemeal. Mixed with the right components it can be one of the most effective healing agents around.

tharal_bonemeal5.m: We used to use it extensively before. But now that bastard Lord Geomyr has banned all use of it.

tharal_bonemeal6.m: How am I supposed to heal people now? Using regular healing potions? Bah, they're so ineffective.

tharal_bonemeal7.m: I know someone that still has a supply of bonemeal if you are interested. Go talk to Thoronir, a fellow priest in Fallhaven. Tell him my password 'Glow of the Shadow'.

bonemeal.10:
Leonid in Crossglen town hall tells me that there was a disturbance in the village some weeks ago. Apparently, Lord Geomyr has banned all use of bonemeal as a healing substance.

Tharal, the town priest should know more.
bonemeal.20: Tharal does not want to talk about bonemeal. I might be able to persuade him by bringing him 5 insect wings.
bonemeal.30: Tharal tells me that bonemeal is a very potent healing substance, and is quite upset that it is not allowed anymore. I should go see Thoronir in Fallhaven if I want to learn more. I should tell him the password 'Glow of the Shadow'.
bonemeal.40: I have talked to Thoronir in Fallhaven. He might be able to mix me a bonemeal potion if I bring him 5 skeletal bones. There should be some skeletons in an abandoned house north of Fallhaven.
bonemeal.50: Thoronir in Fallhaven explained to me that bonemeal potions are banned by Lord Geomyr, so I have refused his request to provide him with fresh ingredients for new bonemeal potions. I could do him a favour though to bring him 5 skeletal bones for church matters. There should be some skeletons in an abandoned house north of Fallhaven.
bonemeal.100:
I have brought the bones to Thoronir. He is now able to supply me with bonemeal potions.
I should be careful when using them though, since Lord Geomyr has banned their use.
bonemeal.110: I have brought the bones to Thoronir. Of course he wouldn't produce any bonemeal potion from them though, since Lord Geomyr has banned their use.

antifoodp.10: I should visit the potion-maker in Fallhaven and ask for something to help against food poisoning.
antifoodp.15: The potion-maker in Fallhaven can create potions that help against food-poisoning.
antifoodp.20: I should bring him a poison gland, two pieces of animal hair and 50 gold pieces, and he'll create a potion for me.
antifoodp.30: I have brought the ingredients for the potion.
antifoodp.35: I received a potion of antidote, that should help me if I get food-poisoning.
antifoodp.40: I can bring him more ingredients if I want him to create more antidote potions in the future.
